## How it was tested

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes (for UI or git behaviour changes)
- [ ] Tested on: Windows / macOS / Linux (strike out what you did not try)
- [ ] Screenshot attached (for UI changes)
- [ ] Touches a [security-sensitive area](https://github.com/TheliosGroupe/GitDesk/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#security-sensitive-areas): a test shows the protection still holds
